name: json_formatter
description: Format/validate/minify JSON, infer a JSON schema from sample data, or compare two JSON objects for differences.

action.description: format/prettify: pretty-print with indentation. validate: check syntax only. minify: remove all whitespace. schema: infer a JSON schema from sample data. compare: diff two JSON objects.

json_str.description: The JSON text. Required for format, validate, minify, prettify, schema.

json1.description: First JSON object. Required for action='compare'.

json2.description: Second JSON object. Required for action='compare'.

sort_keys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically. Only used for action='format'. Defaults to false.
